classification.difficultyReason: Choose time conversion factors and multiply to express a personal age in five units.

answer.short: Answers vary. Multiply age in years by 12; include any additional months.
answer.worked:
For an age of exactly 12 years:
$$\begin{array}{r}12\\\times 12\\\hline24\\120\\\hline144\end{array}$$
Age: 144 months.

answer.short: Answers vary. Approximately 52 weeks per year.
answer.worked:
For an age of exactly 12 years, using approximately 52 weeks per year:
$$\begin{array}{r}52\\\times12\\\hline104\\520\\\hline624\end{array}$$
Age: approximately 624 weeks.

answer.short: Answers vary. Approximately 365 days per year; count leap days for an exact calendar total.
answer.worked:
For an age of exactly 12 years, using 365 days per year:
$$\begin{array}{r}365\\\times12\\\hline730\\3650\\\hline4380\end{array}$$
Age: approximately 4380 days. An exact calendar count includes leap days.

answer.short: Answers vary. Multiply age in days by 24.
answer.worked:
Using the sample estimate of 4380 days:
$$\begin{array}{r}4380\\\times24\\\hline17520\\87600\\\hline105120\end{array}$$
Age: approximately 105 120 hours.

answer.short: Answers vary. Multiply age in hours by 60, then by 60 again.
answer.worked:
Using the sample estimate of 105 120 hours:
$$\begin{array}{r}105120\\\times60\\\hline0\\6307200\\\hline6307200\end{array}$$
This gives 6 307 200 minutes.
$$\begin{array}{r}6307200\\\times60\\\hline0\\378432000\\\hline378432000\end{array}$$
Age: approximately 378 432 000 seconds.
